preprocess_xmkqa: preprocess the xMKQA dataset by splitting multilingual QA examples into per-language JSONL files with English answers
run_preprocess_xmkqa_cli: run the xMKQA preprocessing script with an input JSONL file path and output directory as CLI arguments
filter_xmkqa_answers: filter xMKQA answers to exclude unanswerable, binary, and long answer types keeping only short answers and aliases
split_xmkqa_by_language: split xMKQA examples into separate JSONL files for each of the 26 supported languages
review_preprocess_xmkqa: review the preprocess_xmkqa function to understand how it parses multilingual queries and filters answer types
